description: This file contains a unit test class `EmailMarketingTest` which tests the behavior of the `EmailMarketing` bean in a SuiteCRM environment. It includes tests for object instantiation, retrieval, summary text generation, export query creation, list view data, bean interface implementation, and getting prospect lists.

classes.name: EmailMarketingTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the `EmailMarketing` bean's functionality.

methods.description: Tests the instantiation of `EmailMarketing` bean and verifies its module and schema attributes.

methods.description: Tests the retrieval of an `EmailMarketing` bean using the `retrieve()` method.
